Text alignment modes

JU-A. Editorial shows the book as authored; Left forces ragged text; Justify forces both edges flush. The last line of a paragraph and the lines before a line break are never stretched.

JU-B. This paragraph asks for justified text in its stylesheet, so Editorial must stretch every wrapped line to both edges while the final line stays short, like a printed book would do it.

JU-C. Line break test: the first line of this paragraph is long enough to wrap onto a second line before the break,
and this short line after the break must stay at its natural spacing.

JU-D. This centered paragraph must stay centered in every mode, including Justify, even when it needs several lines on screen.

JU-E. Bold and block break checks follow: class bold and a display block break
after this text.
